```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/people.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
team = data.get("team", {})
members = team.get("members", [])
acknowledgements = data.get("acknowledgements", {})

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# TEAM CARDS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

cards = ""

for member in members:

    name = safe(member.get("name"))
    role = safe(member.get("role"))

    cards += f"""
    <article class="cw-person-card">

      <div class="cw-person-accent"></div>

      <div class="cw-person-content">
        <h3>{name}</h3>
        <p class="cw-person-role">{role}</p>
      </div>

    </article>
    """


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Acknowledgement paragraphs are maintained as trusted
# HTML content by site editors in content/people.yml.
ack_paragraphs = ""

for paragraph in acknowledgements.get("paragraphs", []):
    ack_paragraphs += f"""
    <p>{paragraph}</p>
    """


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-people">

  <!-- HERO -->

  <section class="cw-people-hero">

    <div class="cw-people-hero-content">

      <span class="cw-people-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get("title"))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get("description"))}</p>

    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- TEAM -->

  <section class="cw-people-section">

    <div class="cw-people-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-people-section-label">
        {safe(team.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(team.get("title"))}</h2>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-people-grid">
      {cards}
    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS -->

  <section class="cw-people-acknowledgements">

    <div class="cw-people-acknowledgements-header">

      <span class="cw-people-section-label">
        WEBSITE CREDITS
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(acknowledgements.get("title"))}</h2>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-people-acknowledgements-content">
      {ack_paragraphs}
    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
